evaluation: Independent ordinary requirements-based black-box task QA
strategy: Inspect defaults, exercise core workflow with representative invalid/cancel/outage transitions, compare visible state with requirements, then supplement plant validation categories. Same runner and global budget throughout. Cases evaluated independently; no inferred cross-case outcomes.

budget.stop_reason: 60-action cap reached after bounded coverage of all six cases

findings.title: Cancel removes the episode without confirmation
findings.expected: Cancel closes dialog and retains Morning Birds then River Sounds, count 2; later removal remains possible.
findings.observed: After Cancel only River Sounds and 1 episode queued remain. Subsequent Remove Morning Birds click times out because the control is absent.
findings.impact: Cancellation causes unintended removal and blocks the requested later confirmation workflow.
findings.repeat_scope: See observed text; no claim of unseen trials or internal cause.

findings.title: Valid corrections remain trapped by validation
findings.expected: After rejecting 0, saving corrected 1 or 14 succeeds, identifies Fern and interval, and removes obsolete error.
findings.observed: Both valid corrected values remain visible, but each Save leaves Enter a whole number from 1 to 14 and No care note saved. A second loaded-page sequence 50–60 with empty/abc/1.5/15 then valid 5 ends identically.
findings.impact: User cannot recover and save a valid care note after invalid submission.
findings.repeat_scope: See observed text; no claim of unseen trials or internal cause.

findings.title: Retry and later preview overwrite Avoid stairs choice
findings.expected: Avoid stairs survives outage and retry, yielding Riverside ramp, 1.2 km, no stairs; a later Avoid stairs preview also yields that route.
findings.observed: Outage initially preserves Avoid stairs. Retry switches selection to Shortest path and displays Hill steps, 0.8 km, includes stairs. Explicitly choosing Avoid stairs again and Preview walk repeats the wrong selection and route.
findings.impact: Requested stair-free route cannot be produced in the tested recovery or subsequent preview.
findings.repeat_scope: See observed text; no claim of unseen trials or internal cause.

expected_simulation: First-preview temporary outages in H8C and D3W are required and are not defects.

J2N cancel violation observed once; direct confirm after reload does not establish cancel correctness.
R5B invalid categories after the first invalid submission show rejection, but sticky error means independent validator behavior for subsequent categories is not isolated.
